governing_invariant: provider_attested must declare scope and direction; provider identity does not imply model/session identity or institutional authority

evidence: OpenAI-managed client certificate presented by ChatGPT to MCP servers
certificate chain can be validated against OpenAI-published CA; SAN expected mtls.prod.connectors.openai.com
CIMD provides stable ChatGPT client metadata identity
private_key_jwt can be verified against OpenAI-published JWKS

strongest_surfaces.surface: OpenAI API / Codex workload identity federation
evidence: external OIDC JWT, SPIFFE JWT-SVID, or supported X.509 identity can be exchanged for short-lived OpenAI access token
mapping targets OpenAI service account or managed ChatGPT workspace principal

providers.prohibited_overclaim: Do not label a specific GPT model or ChatGPT conversation/session provider-attested from MCP client identity alone.

evidence: Google service accounts are workload principals
Google IAM can issue short-lived OIDC ID tokens and sign JWTs
Gemini API authorization keys are bound to Google Cloud service accounts

strongest_surfaces.surface: Gemini Enterprise Agent Platform agent identity
evidence: agent identity can use SPIFFE X.509 certificate, OIDC ID token, 2LO credential, or API key
audit logs can record the agent identity and delegated user identity
TYME Cloudflare telemetry independently observed Google LLC / ASN 15169 retrieval of Blind-002 via Google-Lens

providers.prohibited_overclaim: Do not promote consumer Gemini app/browser labels or Google-Lens retrieval telemetry to a specific Gemini model/session identity.

strongest_surfaces.surface: Claude API identity-backed keys and service accounts
evidence: personal and service-account API keys are identity-backed
Admin API exposes principal metadata for managed API keys
Anthropic verifies external OIDC JWT against configured issuer/rule
Anthropic returns short-lived access token bound to target service account
jti replay protection is supported by default
Apple App Attest proves genuine registered iOS/macOS app installation to Anthropic
Anthropic issues short-lived token scoped to workspace

providers.prohibited_overclaim: Do not treat an Anthropic API key, WIF token exchange, or App Attest token as Claude model/session attestation to TYME unless Anthropic publishes a TYME-verifiable assertion surface.

evidence: API keys authenticate to xAI
management records bind API keys to team and creating user
xAI validates enterprise client certificates against customer-provided CA and requires API key
certificate proves authorized client machine to xAI

providers.prohibited_overclaim: Do not treat xAI API-key ownership or client mTLS as xAI-signed Grok identity to TYME.

evidence: can use TYME-enrolled Ed25519 key
can optionally layer SPIFFE, TPM/TEE, platform app attestation, or operator attestation

providers.prohibited_overclaim: No upstream provider exists to attest model identity unless a distributor/runtime operator becomes an explicit attestation authority.

ranked_next_adapters.reason: Strong provider-to-TYME transport identity is explicitly documented and cryptographically verifiable via OpenAI-managed mTLS; CIMD/private_key_jwt can add a second OpenAI-controlled client identity signal.
Google-signed OIDC or SPIFFE agent/workload identity can be independently verified by TYME when a Google workload or Agent Platform agent calls the Hall.

Identity-backed service accounts/WIF are strong client-to-Anthropic identity, but no outward Claude model/session attestation surface was found; keep as evidence adapter unless a verifiable outward assertion appears.
Team/user-bound API keys and enterprise mTLS are useful account/client evidence but authenticate the client to xAI, not Grok to TYME.
